version_or_date_checked: iOS v122 (released 2026-09-29), Android updated 2026-09-22; docs/feature pages checked 2026-10-02
pricing: Free core (programs, progression engine, logging, history, sync, import/export). Premium US: $4.99/month, $39.99/year (14-day free trial on subscriptions), $99.99 lifetime; localized per country. Paywalled: plates-per-side calculator, graphs, muscle maps, Week Insights, rest-timer notifications + Live Activity/Dynamic Island, Apple Watch app, REST API & MCP.
platforms: iOS 17+ (iPhone/iPad, Apple Silicon Mac, visionOS), Apple Watch (watchOS 10.6+, Premium), Android (thin wrapper around PWA, Health Connect, Live Update), web app/PWA at liftosaur.com/app, desktop web program editor; no Wear OS.
positioning: Open-source (AGPL), 'scriptable' strength tracker where every program and progression rule is plain text (Liftoscript) that the app executes automatically after each workout.

features.how: Each set has Reps and Weight (lb/kg or % of 1RM); optional logged RPE; timed sets record a set time (Time column, L/R for unilateral). No distance/cardio fields found in the docs; weight can be left empty and typed at completion.

Warm-up sets (auto-generated or 'warmup:' section), working sets, AMRAP ('5+'), ask-RPE ('@8+'), ask-weight ('100lb+' / '?+'), set labels like '(Main)', timed/count-up sets and EMOM/Tabata via 'auto'. No dedicated drop-set or failure tag; drop sets must be written as extra set groups.

RPE is native: '@8' sets a target RPE, '@8+' asks for completed RPE (0-10, step 0.5) after the set; RPE with no weight auto-derives weight from 1RM+reps+RPE. RIR is not a native field (can be emulated with a user-prompted state variable).

The expanded set shows 'Last', 'Best' and (multi-week programs) 'Same day' results with dates; AMRAP sets show 'Best AMRAP'. 'Add Set' copies the last set or the last set of the previous workout; the target column can be cycled to 'Previous Set'.
features.user_feedback: App Store 2024-04 (3*): it 'pulls my reps and weight from a different day' when the same exercise has different targets on different days. https://itunes.apple.com/us/rss/customerreviews/id=1661880849/sortBy=mostRecent/json

features.how: Targets come from the program text after progression scripts ran; % of 1RM and RPE targets are resolved to concrete weights and rounded to your loadable plates. Swapped-in exercises get weights converted from your history at the closest rep count/RPE, or from 1RM/default starting weight.

Per-workout notes (kebab > Show Workout Notes) and per-exercise workout notes, shown next time as 'Previous Note' for two months; persistent Markdown exercise notes on the exercise screen; Markdown program descriptions per exercise/day/week ('//' lines). No per-set notes found.

Any number of exercises share a group name ('superset: A'); after each working set the screen jumps to the next exercise in the group, skipping finished ones; colored line under thumbnails. Groups can be set in program text, editor, or ad hoc during a workout; separate Superset rest timer.
Long-tap an exercise thumbnail in the top strip and drag to reorder during the workout; program editor grid supports drag of exercises/days/weeks.

Cog > Swap Exercise; picker has Ad-hoc and From Program tabs, 'Similar Muscles' sort, and a Recent list (last 5 swaps). Weights are recalculated from history for the new exercise; swap affects this workout only; pre-defined alternatives with their own progression can be kept via 'used: none'.
Plates per side shown under the expanded set, under the weight keyboard and as a Plates column; free users see a 'See plates for each side' link. Rounding to loadable weights itself is free.
Warm-ups are added automatically by default per exercise; customizable per exercise with 'warmup: 1x5 45lb, 1x3 80%' where % is of the first working set weight, or 'warmup: none'.

Equipment switches 'Bodyweight for Bar' and 'Is assisting?' model weighted and assisted pull-ups/dips; bands are added as 'plates' with assistance weight. Requires a small update script (weights = bodyweight +/- originalWeights) documented with examples.
Exercises flagged 'Is Unilateral' get separate L: and R: rep fields; AMRAP asks left/right reps; timed sets run two clocks. Volume sums both sides; e1RM uses the average of sides.
No tempo field or tempo timer in Liftoscript; tempo can only be written as an exercise description ('//' Markdown) or a set label (max 8 chars).
features.user_feedback: App Store 2026-06 (5*): user keeps 'tempos, RIR targets ... all of it' in the Liftoscript text. https://itunes.apple.com/us/rss/customerreviews/id=1661880849/sortBy=mostRecent/json

features.how: 'Ad-Hoc Workout' starts an empty workout and opens the Add Exercises picker (multi-select). After finishing, 'Create Program Day' turns it into a new or existing program's day.
features.user_feedback: App Store 2026-07 (4*): complained there was no way to save a past training day to a program (current docs describe a Create Program Day action). https://itunes.apple.com/us/rss/customerreviews/id=1661880849/sortBy=mostRecent/json

features.how: Open a past workout from Home: edit sets, swap/remove exercises, change date and length (hh:mm), add notes, delete. Saving does not rerun progressions. Past workouts can also be imported via CSV.

Big Reps/Weight fields and big checkmark; custom keypad with +/- that steps by the smallest loadable weight; swipe between exercises; sets can be completed from the iOS Live Activity / Android notification without unlocking (Premium). Text-size slider 12-24 and optional Always On Display.
features.user_feedback: App Store 2026-05 (3*): 'slow input' - typing faster than the app keeps up drops input. https://itunes.apple.com/us/rss/customerreviews/id=1661880849/sortBy=mostRecent/json

features.how: Rest timer starts automatically when a set is checked (or when the AMRAP/RPE popup is submitted); pill shows elapsed vs target, turns red past target and keeps counting; -15s/+15s.
Priority: per-set rest in program text ('3x5 90s') > Superset timer > Warmup (default 90s) or Workout (default 180s) timer from Me > Timers.

With Premium: push notification when rest ends, with next set and plates ('Next Set: Bench Press, 5 reps, 100lb'); chime over other audio, via headphones when locked with Apple Watch paired; Android 'Ignore Do Not Disturb'.
features.user_feedback: App Store 2026-07 (4*): Apple Watch notifications bugged. https://itunes.apple.com/us/rss/customerreviews/id=1661880849/sortBy=mostRecent/json

features.how: Premium iOS Live Activity + Dynamic Island show workout time, set dots, next set and plates, rest timer with +/-15s, and a tappable set card that completes the set from the lock screen; Android Live Update chip/ongoing notification with Done button.

Timed sets 'Plank / 3x1 60s|30s': Get Ready countdown (default 5s), set clock, auto-complete at target; '30s+' counts up past target (hold as long as possible); 'Stop & record' and 'Log, keep timing'; recorded time editable.
Header shows workout time with a pause/resume button; duration shown on summary and history cards and editable on past workouts.

If you leave the app with a workout running, a 'Workout reminder' notification fires after a delay (default 900 s, configurable, 0=off). The cloud keeps one open workout per account; it can be continued on another device or discarded.
Workouts are days inside a program; you can have multiple programs and switch the current one. A day can also be created from an ad-hoc workout.

Programs are a flat 'Yours' list next to 'Built-in'; no folders/categories described. Not described anywhere in the official per-feature docs, which claim to cover 'everything the app does' (checked 2026-10-02).

About 60 built-in programs (GZCLP and GZCL family, 5/3/1 variants, Starting Strength, PHUL, Basic Beginner Routine, Strong Curves...) filterable by experience, days/week, session length and goal; preview every day; clone into your own editable copy.
Multi-week programs ('# Week N'), % of 1RM, RPE targets, set variations, per-week overrides, deload weeks via 'progress: none', lp() with deload-after-N-failures parameters; everything scriptable.

No built-in generator; AI generation happens in external assistants (ChatGPT plugin, Claude/Gemini via MCP) that read the Liftoscript reference, write a program, test it with run_playground and save it. Account-touching tools need Premium.
features.user_feedback: App Store 2026-09 (5*): 'I told ChatGPT what I wanted ... it created a workout program for me, and now I track everything in Liftosaur.' https://itunes.apple.com/us/rss/customerreviews/id=1661880849/sortBy=mostRecent/json

features.how: Programs run as an ordered sequence of days with a 'Next Day' pointer; you can pick any day as next. No calendar-date scheduling; week start (Sun/Mon) setting only affects history/insights.

Program menu: public short link (liftosaur.com/p/...) with custom exercises and units, program image with QR code, private link for laptop editing, export all programs as text. Links are immutable snapshots.
Docs say 'hundreds of built-in exercises'; the public directory lists ~364 exercise+equipment combinations (counted 2026-10-02).
Each exercise has an image/thumbnail and muscle map; web exercise pages give text 'How to perform ... with proper form' steps. No exercise videos found.

Name, image (library/camera/photo, account needed to upload), target/synergist muscles, types, Markdown notes; 'Autofill Muscles and Types' asks an AI model; 'Clone from another exercise'. Renaming updates program text.
Target and synergist muscles and groups per exercise; per-user 'Override Muscles' with 0-1 multipliers; custom muscle groups (e.g., split delts), hide built-in groups.
Filter by equipment, type (Core/Pull/Push/Legs/Upper/Lower), muscle groups or single muscles; 'Show only available equipment' hides exercises needing hidden equipment.
Search matches name and equipment words ('incline dumbbell'); favorites star; multi-select add; sort by name or Similar Muscles.
App Store lists English only; docs and exercise names are English.

Rule-based: per-exercise 'progress:' runs at workout finish and rewrites program text: lp(increment, successes, ..., deload weight, failures), dp(), sum(), or custom() scripts with state variables reading completedReps/RPE/weights. Preview of 'Exercise Changes' shown under the sets; can be suppressed once.
dp(5lb, 8, 12): reps climb within the range until the top on every set, then weight increases and reps reset.
lp() takes a deload amount and number of failed sessions; editor pill 'Add deload on failure'; deload weeks via 'progress: none'; custom scripts can implement any reset logic.

No readiness/recovery model; sleep, calories and protein are only read from Health for display/API. Not described anywhere in the official per-feature docs, which claim to cover 'everything the app does' (checked 2026-10-02).

No in-app AI coach; ChatGPT plugin and MCP server (Claude, Gemini) let an assistant edit programs, log workouts and analyze history including sleep/protein. In-app AI only autofills custom exercise muscles.
features.user_feedback: App Store 2026-03 (5*): 'The MCP tool with Claude makes it super easy for programming workout plans.' https://itunes.apple.com/us/rss/customerreviews/id=1661880849/sortBy=mostRecent/json

features.how: Per exercise: Max Weight and Max 1RM (e1RM) with date and set; trophy on history cards; finish screen lists new PRs; Week Insights shows PRs vs previous best; Last/Best/Best AMRAP during sets. No per-rep-count record table described.

e1RM = weight / (share of 1RM from an RPE chart for reps at RPE), RPE 10 assumed if none logged; chart follows the OpenPowerlifting RPE calculator (5 reps @ 200 lb -> ~231 lb). Unilateral uses average of sides.

Graphs tab (Premium): per exercise Max Weight (with e1RM line) or Volume, long-press for set/notes/state, pinch zoom, program-change lines, bodyweight overlay. Free users still see PR list; graphs are blurred.
features.user_feedback: App Store 2024-05 (3*): 'New update put graphs behind paywall when it was free a week ago.' https://itunes.apple.com/us/rss/customerreviews/id=1661880849/sortBy=mostRecent/json

features.how: Weekly sets/volume per muscle group graphs; Week Insights and program week stats show sets per muscle vs configurable ranges (presets Novice 10-12/Intermediate 13-15/Advanced 16-20, frequency targets, synergist multiplier 0.5), strength (<8 reps) vs hypertrophy split. Week Insights and muscle views are Premium; web editor shows week stats.
features.user_feedback: App Store 2026-09 (4*): post-workout summary volume reported ~4000 too high and sets exclude warm-ups. https://itunes.apple.com/us/rss/customerreviews/id=1661880849/sortBy=mostRecent/json

features.how: Front/back body drawing shading muscles by sets for a week, a program week or a day ('Day Muscles'), with Strength/Hypertrophy tabs and relative percentages; Premium.
Week strip and month calendar of workouts with per-month workout and PR counts; week-over-week deltas. No streak feature described.
'Congratulations!' screen after Finish: time, volume, sets, reps, exercises, sets per muscle group, new PRs, share buttons.
No strength standards or percentile comparison. Not described anywhere in the official per-feature docs, which claim to cover 'everything the app does' (checked 2026-10-02).

Log bodyweight with any date (backfill), list + graph (graph Premium), optional moving average (2-5 values, Premium) that also feeds the Liftoscript 'bodyweight' variable; can sync from Apple Health/Health Connect.
Body fat % plus 13 sites (neck, shoulders, L/R biceps, forearms, thighs, calves, chest, waist, hips) in cm/in; choose which types are enabled; graphs Premium.

Measurements cover bodyweight, body fat and 13 sites only; no progress photos. Not described anywhere in the official per-feature docs, which claim to cover 'everything the app does' (checked 2026-10-02).

Reads sleep, dietary calories and protein (one total/day) from Apple Health (90 days) or Health Connect (30 days) for graphs and API; watch/AirPods heart rate during workouts. No readiness score or check-in.

Writes finished workouts (strength training, active kcal = 6 kcal/min) and bodyweight/body fat/waist; reads bodyweight, body fat, waist, sleep, calories, protein. Android uses Health Connect. Past workouts can be synced manually.
features.user_feedback: App Store 2026-02 (3*): Health sync repeatedly failing with error messages during workouts. https://itunes.apple.com/us/rss/customerreviews/id=1661880849/sortBy=mostRecent/json

features.how: Apple Watch app (Premium): start/continue workouts, log sets with Digital Crown (weights step through loadable values), AMRAP/RPE prompts, timed sets, rest timer, heart rate, works without the phone via direct server sync, complications. Cannot swap exercises or change targets on watch. No official Wear OS app.
features.user_feedback: App Store 2026-02 (5*): 'latest update that added watch support' made it a must-have; 2025-09 reviewers had listed missing Watch support as the only gap. https://itunes.apple.com/us/rss/customerreviews/id=1661880849/sortBy=mostRecent/json

features.how: No official Garmin/Wear OS/Fitbit integration; community projects use the API (e.g., unofficial Wear OS client, Liftosaur-to-Garmin FIT converters).

Import history from Hevy CSV or Liftosaur CSV with preview (suspicious values, duplicates within 1 min skipped), undo of last 5 imports; JSON full restore; program JSON; program links. No direct Strong import.
Export everything to JSON (restorable), history to CSV (one row per set incl. warm-ups, RPE, time, muscles, notes), all programs as Liftoscript text.
Offline-first: data saved on device, optional account syncs after every change and pushes to other devices; per-entity last-write-wins merge; live workout continues across phone/web.

No home-screen widgets described; only Apple Watch complications (Up Next / Ongoing). Not described anywhere in the official per-feature docs, which claim to cover 'everything the app does' (checked 2026-10-02).

No Siri/Shortcuts integration described; automation is via REST API instead. Not described anywhere in the official per-feature docs, which claim to cover 'everything the app does' (checked 2026-10-02).
Multiple gyms (Manage Gyms > Add/duplicate); 'Current Gym' switch changes equipment used by every exercise; per-gym equipment mapping per exercise.

Per equipment: bar weight, sides (1-4), plate counts (only pairs count), fixed-weight lists for dumbbells/kettlebells/stacks, unit per equipment; custom equipment types. Targets are rounded down to the heaviest loadable weight with a 'Why is the weight adjusted?' explanation.
Hidden equipment hides its exercises from the picker by default ('Show only available equipment').
No feed, followers or friends; only an optional public profile page. Not described anywhere in the official per-feature docs, which claim to cover 'everything the app does' (checked 2026-10-02).
Finish screen: IG Story/Feed, TikTok image (optionally over your photo), text copy, public link to the workout; optional public profile page with main lifts progress graphs.
No leaderboards. Not described anywhere in the official per-feature docs, which claim to cover 'everything the app does' (checked 2026-10-02).
No challenges. Not described anywhere in the official per-feature docs, which claim to cover 'everything the app does' (checked 2026-10-02).
No trainer/client accounts. Not described anywhere in the official per-feature docs, which claim to cover 'everything the app does' (checked 2026-10-02).
No coach role, but a coach can send a program link/QR image that the athlete imports (with unit conversion); API keys allow external tooling.
No coach feedback/review flow. Not described anywhere in the official per-feature docs, which claim to cover 'everything the app does' (checked 2026-10-02).
No in-app chat; support via email and Discord. Not described anywhere in the official per-feature docs, which claim to cover 'everything the app does' (checked 2026-10-02).
No marketplace; built-in program library plus free public program links. There is an affiliate program for sharers.

Core is free (programs, editor, Liftoscript, progressions, logging, history, measurement entry, equipment, sharing, import/export, sync). Premium (US: $4.99/mo, $39.99/yr, $99.99 lifetime; 14-day trial on subs; store-localized prices) unlocks plates per side, graphs, muscle views, rest-timer notifications/Live Activity, Week Insights, Apple Watch, API & MCP. Bought only in iOS/Android apps, works on all platforms.
features.user_feedback: App Store 2025-11/2026-03 (5*): praised lifetime option; 'everything you need including progression is free'. https://itunes.apple.com/us/rss/customerreviews/id=1661880849/sortBy=mostRecent/json

features.how: Global kg/lb and cm/in; per-equipment unit override (e.g., kg stack in lb gym, shown in kg in workout/history while graphs stay in default unit); automatic conversion when cloning/importing programs.
Follows system light/dark by default; Dark mode override in Me > Appearance.
English only (App Store language list: English).
In-app text size slider 12-24 that defaults to device text size and scales icons/thumbnails. VoiceOver support not documented.
5 intro slides, pick units, equipment and plates, then built-in/create/import/no program; guided tours on workout screen and editors until 4 workouts finished; '?' replays tours.
features.user_feedback: Many App Store reviews mention a learning curve for Liftoscript (e.g., 2026-04, 2026-02, 2025-11). https://itunes.apple.com/us/rss/customerreviews/id=1661880849/sortBy=mostRecent/json

features.how: Works fully without account or connection; only the built-in program list needs a connection; web app caches itself for offline use.

No account required; sign-in with Apple/Google/email optional; several local accounts per phone; 'Delete Current Cloud Account' wipes server data (payment records kept). App Store label lists health/fitness, email, IDs and usage data linked to identity.

Programs are plain text: 'Exercise / sets x reps weight @RPE / rest / warmup: / progress: / update: / superset:'; weeks '#', days '##', reuse ('...Bench Press'), templates ('used: none'), labels, descriptions; JS-like scripting with state variables, loops, tags and built-in functions.
'update: custom()' runs before the first set and after each completed set to modify remaining sets in the current workout (e.g., add a set if reps hit target, set weight = bodyweight).
Simulate workouts without touching history: complete sets, finish days and walk through weeks to see weights, reps and state variables change; also on program previews and web editor.

liftosaur.com/planner desktop editor (no account needed) with autocomplete, regex find/replace, multi-cursor, week stats and preview; private links edit the live account program; full app also runs as installable PWA at liftosaur.com/app.

In-app editor has 4 modes (calendar grid with drag-and-drop, per-day UI, per-day text, full text) with contextual 'pills' that write syntax; signed-in users can restore any of the last 100 saved versions.

API keys (lftsk_...) give read/write to programs, history, measurements, gyms/equipment, exercise data; /api/v1/workout/* runs the program engine server-side (start, log sets, finish with progressions). Premium + account required.

MCP server at liftosaur.com/mcp (OAuth or API key) for Claude/Gemini/other clients plus a ChatGPT plugin: tools to CRUD programs, history, custom exercises, gyms, measurements, run_playground and get_program_stats. Reference tools free; account tools Premium.

When a computed target is not loadable, the exact weight is crossed out and the rounded one underlined; tapping it opens 'Why is the weight adjusted?' explaining 1RM %, unit conversion, bar, plates or closest dumbbell.

Per-muscle-group weekly set ranges and frequency targets with color coding and arrows (add/remove sets), strength/hypertrophy split targets, editable presets; shared by Week Insights and program week stats.
Calculator from the 1RM field or weight keypad: enter reps/RPE/weight achieved and target reps/RPE to get a weight ('Use it!'); also public web calculators.
Optional public page liftosaur.com/profile/<id> with nickname, current program, main/rest lift max and progress graphs.
Several local accounts on one phone, each with its own programs/history/settings; switch without losing data.
Source code public on GitHub under AGPL-3.0; Preact/TypeScript PWA wrapped in thin native iOS/Android apps.
Heart rate shown on the workout screen from Apple Watch, or from AirPods if no watch (v122, Sep 2026).
Optional setting keeps the screen awake while the app is open.
